s.item: THE CONTROL SWEEP — B1078's denominator-purity criterion (lambda's denominator a bare unramified value-prime of K, free of {3,7,11}) tested on every C-compatible-or-not diagonal outside the coboundary coset {I, chi_a, chi_b, D2}: the full 16-row X^tau table plus the other Klein four {I, D, D_c, D_cD}
s.headline: 18 gauges total (4 coset + 14 new controls: all 16 X^tau rows, cross-checked by two independent constructions, plus D_c/D_cD from the {I,D,D_c,D_cD} Klein four), lambda re-computed exactly at every one via B923's own gauge-generic pipeline (qCL cross-checked bit-for-bit against B914's banked data; git status clean throughout). THE HEADLINE FINDING: D's cohomology class (1,1) EXACTLY REPRODUCES the coset's entire 1-of-3 pattern, value for value — D2D = D2's own 2304/953 (PASS), and two structurally-DIFFERENT new diagonals (12 and 15 flips, vs chi_a's 16 and chi_b's 11) reproduce chi_a's 864/413 and chi_b's 6912/3047 EXACTLY (both FAIL, same primes 7 and 11) — while the two untouched classes (1,0)/(0,1) (8 members, zero wall-contact) mostly have NO well-defined lambda at all (6 of 8: the colorless and colored sectors give provably different values, three of six coupling triples turn genuinely irrational) and the rest collapse to the trivial lambda=1. The other Klein four {I,D,D_c,D_cD} is uniformly degenerate (lambda=1 at all four; D_c/D_cD's non-S triples are UNDEFINED, q_i q_j q_k=0 exactly). VERDICT: MIXED, precisely — across every one of the 18 gauges tested, NO value other than {1(degenerate), 2304/953, 864/413, 6912/3047} EVER occurs, so the criterion is never diluted by a new false pass or an unexplained new fail (a BITES-shaped fact), but the sweep supplies no independently-sampled new evidence either, since every well-posed non-degenerate control is an exact echo of an already-banked number, not a fresh one. Every lambda value is recorded exactly below regardless of the verdict.

claims.statement: THE CONTROL SET, identified and doubly cross-checked. D (rep_diagonal_of_inner at the all-minus character) matches banked B912 D_diag exactly (12 flips); D2 (inner CHI_M) matches banked B916 D2 exactly (11 flips); D2D (inner CHI_P) equals D2*D pointwise (Klein closure verified, not assumed; 15 flips); D_c (inner CHI_C, B939's compact-flip) is NEW, 12 flips; D_cD (inner CHI_C*ALL_MINUS) equals D_c*D pointwise, 12 flips. Independently, solve_H_outer at chi_a's and chi_b's own raw outer characters reproduces B1076's banked 16-flip and 11-flip diagonals exactly. ALL 16 raw X^tau characters were then run through solve_H_outer (B936's own machinery) to build every one of the 16 gauge-ratios H+^-1.H(sigma_chi.tau), and EVERY ONE was independently cross-checked by a SECOND, structurally different construction (Rchar: the Cartan-mod-2 weight-character homomorphism, C-A2's torsor relation) -- 16/16 match, 0 mismatches, including all 10 previously-uncomputed rows. All 18 gauges (16 X^tau + D_c + D_cD) are pi-symmetric (checked, not assumed). git status --porcelain was clean at every checkpoint; nothing under the repo root was ever opened in write mode.
claims.evidence: scratchpad stageA_diagonals.py + stageA2_rchar_crosscheck.py (session scratchpad, b1078_controls/). Assertions in-code: D==Dd_banked(B912), D2==D2_banked(B916), chi_a/chi_b flip counts (16,11) vs B1076's banked claim, D2*D==D2D, D_c*D==D_cD, all 16 R(chi*CHI_P)==solve_H_outer ratio (printed, 0 mismatches). Cross-referenced against docs/LAW_MAP.md's D2-CHARACTERIZATION row ('the Klein group {I,D2,D,D2D} = the wall pair's 2-torsion in rho27') and B939/results.json's own shadow_summary.

claims.statement: PIPELINE RE-RUN, methodology. A copy of frontier/B923_exactification/exactify.py was executed VERBATIM (only its results.json/cache write path redirected into scratch via a single post-REPO-computation HERE reassignment; every read stayed against the real repo) at its original 2 gauges -- this reproduces B923's own banked verdict in full (V-L2 closed, all steps [1]-[17] PASS, independent numeric route to 2.09e-53) and populates the exact machinery (T3, atoms_ex, the K/N/Mbar towers, hpair_gauge) used for the sweep. qCL['canonical_Hplus'] was checked EQUAL, atom for atom, to B914's own banked q_exact_ncoords (0 mismatches over the 9 colorless/colored atom lines) before being trusted on anything new. For each of the 14 new gauges, qCL was computed by the SAME hpair_gauge bilinear sum (safe: no matrix inversion, so no singular-Gram crash risk) for all 9 atoms; lambda^2 = c^2/(q_i q_j q_k) (B916's own definition, NOT re-derived as CCC/6 -- MB12 discipline, since CCC=3!.lambda is exactly the relation B1076's own audit found FAILS off-coset) was computed on all 6 of B914's banked coupling triples per gauge, using B914's gauge-independent c-values against the freshly-computed gauge-dependent q's, in independently re-transcribed N/K-tower arithmetic (a self-check reproduced lambda(I)^2=-1 from B914's own banked q's before trusting anything downstream).
claims.evidence: scratchpad stageB1_exec_and_qCL.py (exec log: all ~90 checks PASS, 'qCL[canonical_Hplus] vs B914 banked mismatches: []', 'qCL tau-free failures: []', 'git status --porcelain (repo) after exec: (clean)') + stageB2_lambda.py ('Self-check PASSED: ... lambda(I)^2 = -1'). One real failure caught and fixed, not swept: the first pass crashed with StopIteration inside ninv(pq) because q_i.q_j.q_k=0 exactly for several (gauge,triple) pairs -- rewritten to catch this per-triple and record UNDEFINED_zero_product rather than aborting the whole sweep.

claims.statement: THE COSET'S PATTERN IS EXACTLY REPRODUCED, VALUE FOR VALUE, IN D's COHOMOLOGY CLASS (1,1) -- the sharpest single finding of the sweep. Class (1,1) = {D, D2D, and two brand-new X^tau rows} (verified via the coordinate = bits(chi) XOR bits(CHI_P), read at the two tau-fixed nodes, exactly as B936's own H1_class map is defined). D: lambda=1 (degenerate, all 6 triples agree -- the class-(1,1) analogue of I). D2D: lambda=2304/953 = 2^8.3^2/953 -- IDENTICAL to D2 (PASS). The remaining two class-(1,1) members (raw signs (1,1,-1,1,-1,1), 12 flips, and (-1,1,1,1,1,-1), 15 flips -- BOTH provably different diagonals from chi_a/chi_b themselves, since the flip counts differ: chi_a has 16, chi_b has 11) give lambda=864/413 and lambda=6912/3047 EXACTLY -- bit-for-bit identical to chi_a's and chi_b's own banked values (FAIL, containing 7 and 11 respectively). So the entire {degenerate, FAIL(413), FAIL(3047), PASS(953)} shape of the coset is reproduced verbatim by a disjoint set of gauges (different cohomology class, different diagonals) -- not a coincidence of relabeling.
claims.evidence: stageC_verdict.json + the H1-class recomputation (session scratchpad one-liner): Xtau row (signs=(1,1,-1,1,-1,1), 12 flips, coordinate XOR-derived H1_class=(1,1)) -> lambda=864/413; Xtau row (signs=(-1,1,1,1,1,-1), 15 flips, H1_class=(1,1)) -> lambda=6912/3047; D (signs=CHI_M, H1_class=(1,1)) -> lambda=1; D2D (signs=all-ones, H1_class=(1,1)) -> lambda=2304/953. All four cross-checked against B912/B916/B1076's own banked numbers where an overlap exists (D, D2D via the Klein-closure route; the two new rows have no prior banked value -- this is new content).

claims.statement: THE TWO UNTOUCHED CLASSES (1,0) AND (0,1) -- 8 members, none containing any C-compatible/wall-pair census element per B936's own class table -- MOSTLY HAVE NO WELL-DEFINED LAMBDA AT ALL. 6 of the 8 fail a precondition stronger than the denominator-purity criterion itself: lambda^2 is NOT CONSTANT across the 6 named coupling triples (B916's own invariance property, which DOES hold at all 6 members of {I,chi_a,chi_b,D2,D,D2D}). Concretely, at each of these 6 gauges the pure-colorless triple (S0,S1,S2) and the two pure-colored triples ((A0p,A1p,A2p),(A0m,A1m,A2m)) give TWO DIFFERENT rational values sharing the same numerator (the colorless one exactly echoing 2304^2, 864^2, or 6912^2 -- i.e. one of D2/chi_a/chi_b's own squared numerators -- the colored one a companion value with a NEW denominator: 2304/125, 864/35, 6912/275), while all three MIXED triples ((A0m,A0p,S0) etc.) come out with genuine, non-rational K-field content. The remaining 2 of the 8 (one per class) collapse to the trivial lambda=1 with the OTHER 5 of their own 6 triples UNDEFINED (q_i q_j q_k=0 exactly) -- i.e. even their 'pass' has almost no surviving arithmetic to test.
claims.evidence: stageB_lambda.json (raw per-triple report) + stageC_verdict.json. E.g. Xtau row signs=(1,-1,-1,1,-1,1) (class (0,1)): S-triple lam2=5308416/908209=(2304/953)^2 exact, A-triples lam2=5308416/15625=(2304/125)^2 exact (125=5^3), mixed triples rational=False. Xtau row signs=(1,1,-1,-1,-1,1) (class (1,0)): all 6 triples agree, lambda=1 exactly (a genuine degenerate PASS, not undefined) -- the one exception among the 8 that is fully well-posed and trivial rather than partially undefined.

claims.statement: THE OTHER KLEIN FOUR {I, D, D_c, D_cD} (D_c/D_cD are NOT X^tau members -- inner shadows of B939's compact-flip character, a genuinely different construction) IS UNIFORMLY DEGENERATE: all four give lambda=1. D is fully well-posed (all 6 triples agree on lambda=1, matching I's own already-acknowledged degenerate (x+3)^3 status). D_c and D_cD instead show the 'S-only' pattern: the (S0,S1,S2) triple gives lambda=1, but all 5 remaining triples are UNDEFINED (q_i q_j q_k=0 exactly, i.e. at least one colored atom's own self-pairing vanishes under this gauge) -- structurally closer to the broken-down classes (1,0)/(0,1) than to D's own clean degeneracy. So the {I,D,D_c,D_cD} Klein four supplies zero non-trivial arithmetic to test the criterion against, in either direction.
claims.evidence: stageB_lambda.json: D_c statuses=['OK','UNDEFINED_zero_product'x5], the one OK triple = (S0,S1,S2) with lam2=-1 exactly (lambda=1); identical pattern for D_cD. Cross-checked: B939/results.json's own 'shadow_sigma_c_is_Dc_12_flips' confirms D_c's 12-flip count independently of this session's re-derivation.

claims.statement: THE CRITERION'S ARITHMETIC FOUNDATION, independently re-verified THREE ways in-session (beyond the two PARI/GP rounds already banked in this session's own prior scratchpad work, b1078_results.json). K=Q[s]/(s^3-12s-5): field discriminant = 6237 = 3^4.7.11 exactly, O_K=Z[s] (index 1) via sympy's own round_two Dedekind algorithm (independent software from the earlier PARI/GP nfinit computation). Splitting types via sympy's prime_decomp (genuine prime-ideal arithmetic) cross-checked against Dedekind mod-p factorization of s^3-12s-5 (valid since index=1 at every prime, verified) on 14 test primes {2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19,29,59,277,953,421493,1129}: 0 mismatches. Confirms exactly the banked biography: 3 totally ramified (e=3,f=1); 7 and 11 each split as one unramified degree-1 place plus one tamely-ramified (e=2) degree-1 place; 13/17/19 (the structure primes) are INERT [3]; 59/277/953/421493/1129 (the value primes plus their cofactors) all split [1,2] -- the value-prime signature. THE CRITERION (denominator free of {3,7,11}, squarefree, every prime factor [1,2]-split) was calibrated against the three already-banked cases BEFORE being trusted on any new number: D2(953)->PASS, chi_a(413=7.59)->FAIL[7], chi_b(3047=11.277)->FAIL[11] -- all reproduced correctly.
claims.evidence: scratchpad criterion.py, run output: 'K = Q[s]/(s^3-12s-5): field disc = 6237 = 3^4.7.11; O_K = Z[s] (index 1)'; per-prime table with prime_decomp vs dedekind agreement=True on all 14; 'mismatches between the two routes: []'; calibration block reproducing D2/chi_a/chi_b's known verdicts. Cross-referenced against docs/THEOREM_LEDGER.md's C28 row ('disc K = 6237 = 3^4.7.11, one line from the reduced model x^3-12x-5') and the locked test tests/test_c28_ramification.py.

claims.statement: THE FULL TALLY (18 gauges: 4 coset + 14 controls). Non-degenerate PASS (denominator = a single unramified [1,2]-value prime): D2 (2304/953), D2D (2304/953, same value) -- 2 of 18. Non-degenerate FAIL (denominator contains one of {7,11}): chi_a (864/413), chi_b (6912/3047), plus the two class-(1,1) echoes carrying the identical values -- 4 of 18 total occurrences of exactly 2 distinct values. Trivially degenerate (lambda=1, denominator=1, vacuous pass -- no cubic, no hierarchy content, matching I's own already-excluded status): I, D, D_c, D_cD, and 2 further X^tau rows -- 6 of 18. No well-defined lambda at all: 6 of 18 (all in classes (1,0)/(0,1)). Net: across every gauge this sweep could reach, the pipeline NEVER produced a lambda value other than {1, 2304/953, 864/413, 6912/3047} -- no new PASS, no new FAIL, no fourth number.
claims.evidence: stageC_verdict.json, full 16-row table (14 new + I + D2; chi_a/chi_b counted from B1076's own banked, re-confirmed-in-Stage-A values) -- programmatic tally: PASS(non-trivial)=2, FAIL=2 (distinct-value occurrences at the new-gauge level; +2 more at the already-banked chi_a/chi_b level), trivial(lambda=1)=6, undefined=6; sums to 16 (+2 banked = 18).

claims.statement: SUPPLEMENTARY EXACT NUMBERS (new facts, recorded regardless of the verdict, per the mission's own instruction): the three 'A-sector echo' values found at the 6 undefined-lambda gauges are NOT a lambda (the S- and A-sectors disagree, so no single number qualifies), but are themselves new, exact, reproducible facts: 2304/125 (=2^8.3^2/5^3), 864/35 (=2^5.3^3/(5.7)), 6912/275 (=2^8.3^3/(5^2.11)). Run through THE CRITERION as a curiosity (not part of the main tally, since they are not lambda): all three FAIL -- 864/35 and 6912/275 fail via the identical ramified-prime mechanism as chi_a/chi_b (7 and 11 respectively, now paired with an extra factor of 5), while 2304/125 fails on squarefreeness alone (5^3), a DIFFERENT and milder failure mode than a ramified-prime hit -- the one case in the entire sweep where a D2-echo-adjacent number does not pass cleanly.
claims.evidence: criterion.py applied to 35, 125, 275: 'FAIL [contains K-ramified prime(s) [7]] {5:1,7:1}'; 'FAIL [not squarefree: [5]...] {5:3}'; 'FAIL [contains K-ramified prime(s) [11], not squarefree...] {5:2,11:1}'. Source values from stageB_lambda.json's per-triple entries at the 6 Group-C gauges (e.g. signs=(1,1,1,-1,1,1): A-triples lam2=47775744/75625, sqrt=6912/275 exact).

claims.statement: CORROBORATING (not decisive, a different control family already in this session's scratchpad, b1078_results.json): B1078's own prior supplementary check reused B1076's generic, non-X^tau, off-B^1 MB12 controls -- controlA (lambda=24606358239/12111475315, denominator 5.199.3461.3517) and controlA3 (lambda=3398045192/1223153581, denominator 13.953.98729) -- neither has THE CRITERION's clean shape: controlA fails via 4 unrelated mid-size primes (none of them structure- or value-primes), controlA3 fails by mixing the structure prime 13 with the value prime 953 and an unrelated large prime. Both are independently confirmed FAIL under this session's own criterion.py. A genuinely different failure texture from chi_a/chi_b's clean single-ramified-prime hits, but the same overall verdict: 0/2.
claims.evidence: criterion(12111475315) and criterion(1223153581) both return pass=False (multi-prime, non-bare denominators; 1223153581 additionally contains the structure-adjacent composite with 13). Source: (scratchpad) claim 'ELEMENT 6B' (already-banked in this session, read not recomputed for its own numbers, but the criterion re-applied to them fresh).

claims.statement: THE VERDICT: MIXED, stated precisely. In the BITES direction: across all 18 gauges tested (essentially the full X^tau plus the adjacent Klein four), the criterion is NEVER diluted -- no gauge anywhere produces an unexplained new PASS or an unexplained new FAIL; every non-degenerate result is exactly one of D2's, chi_a's, or chi_b's own numbers, recurring in a disjoint cohomology class (1,1) with the identical PASS/FAIL/FAIL/degenerate shape. In the VACUOUS direction: the sweep supplies no INDEPENDENTLY SAMPLED new evidence -- it does not exhibit a fourth, previously-unseen value that also passes or fails on its own merits; most of the ambient structure (12 of 14 controls) either cannot even pose the question (6 gauges, no well-defined lambda) or answers it only vacuously (6 gauges at lambda=1, zero hierarchy content). The honest reading: THE CRITERION's true domain of non-trivial applicability is exactly {I,chi_a,chi_b,D2} union {D,D2D,+2 echoes} -- a locus tied to the wall-pair/C-compatible structure (B936's own class table), not a generic property of coboundary-adjacent gauges -- and on that domain it is airtight (1-of-3, twice, with zero exceptions), while everywhere else in X^tau the pipeline's own notion of 'lambda' itself breaks down before the criterion could even be posed.
claims.evidence: Direct synthesis of claims 1-8; no computation beyond what is cited there. Gate 5 respected throughout: no measured/experimental number entered or was compared at any point in this sweep.

s.fail_witnesses: Real, in-sandbox-caught issues, none swept under the rug: (1) The first lambda-extraction pass crashed with StopIteration inside ninv() because q_i.q_j.q_k=0 exactly for several (gauge, triple) combinations (D_c, D_cD, and 4 X^tau rows on all 5 of their non-(S0,S1,S2) triples) -- rewritten to catch this per-triple and record UNDEFINED_zero_product rather than aborting or silently forcing a value; this UNDEFINED status is itself load-bearing in claims 4-5, not just a bug workaround. (2) A first attempt to pickle the exec'd exactify.py's own functions across processes failed (PicklingError: functions defined via exec() are not importable) -- fixed by pickling DATA only and re-transcribing the small pure K/N-tower arithmetic functions verbatim, then SELF-CHECKED by reproducing lambda(I)^2=-1 from B914's own banked q-values before trusting the re-transcription on anything new (it matched exactly). (3) The naive assumption 'lambda is always a single rational, constant across all 6 triples' (true at the 6 gauges of claim 3) was NOT assumed to hold generally -- extract_lambda() explicitly checks all(rational) and len(distinct values)==1 before reporting a lambda, and correctly returned NON-RATIONAL/MULTI for the 6 Group-C gauges rather than picking one triple's value and calling it lambda (which would have been an MB12 violation -- cherry-picking a definition to force an answer). (4) Calibration test (claim 6): criterion.py was run against the three ALREADY-KNOWN cases (D2 PASS, chi_a/chi_b FAIL) BEFORE being trusted on any new number -- could have failed (a bug would have shown up as a wrong verdict on a known case), did not. (5) Every cross-check that COULD have failed and did not: D/D2/chi_a/chi_b vs their banked diagonals (4 checks), D2*D==D2D and D_c*D==D_cD (Klein closure, 2 checks), qCL[canonical_Hplus] vs B914's banked q's (9 atoms), all 16 X^tau rows via Rchar vs solve_H_outer (16 checks), sympy round_two vs the session's own prior PARI/GP field-discriminant computation, sympy prime_decomp vs Dedekind mod-p factorization (14 primes) -- 45+ independent checks, 0 failures. git status --porcelain was clean at every checkpoint (confirmed repeatedly through the session, including at its end); nothing under the repo root was ever written to.
s.notes: Scope and registration: (1) The colored-Gram/CCC bonus computation (mirroring B1076's own cross-check that CCC=3!.lambda fails off-coset) was deliberately NOT attempted for the new controls -- it requires re-transcribing a materially more complex tensor contraction (gram_colored/ftinv3/emb_gram_inv) with real bug risk for a genuinely optional cross-check; lambda itself (the mission's actual target) does not depend on it and was computed via the safe, inversion-free qCL route throughout. (2) Registered open, not investigated (mirroring B1076's own 'no simple arithmetic relation found... registered open' discipline): WHY the A-sector-echo denominators are exactly {5^3, 5.7, 5.11} (claim 8) -- a factor of 5 keyed to which coset member is echoed, unexplained; WHY classes (1,0)/(0,1) specifically are the ones that break down (they are the two classes with zero wall-pair/C-compatible membership per B936's own table, which is suggestive but not a proof of causation here); WHY two DIFFERENT diagonals (12 and 15 flips) reproduce chi_a's and chi_b's exact numbers bit-for-bit -- confirmed as a genuine fact (both diagonals independently verified, provably different from chi_a/chi_b's own), not chased to a mechanism. (3) Observed, not caused by this session: the repository's git branch/HEAD shifted during this run (started on 'b826-b519-verdict' per the task's opening context, ended on 'main', 2 commits ahead of origin) -- consistent with concurrent seats in this multi-agent repo; every git status check performed by this session, at every checkpoint, showed a clean working tree, and no file under the repo root was ever opened in write mode by any script in this sweep. (4) All working files (stageA_diagonals.py/.json, stageA2_rchar_crosscheck.py, stageB1_exec_and_qCL.py, stageB1_state.pkl, stageB1_qCL.json, stageB2_lambda.py, stageB_lambda.json, criterion.py, stageC_verdict.py, stageC_verdict.json) are in the session scratchpad at b1078_controls/, available for inspection or re-run.

v.item: THE SWEEP — B1078's denominator-purity criterion tested across all 18 non-coboundary-coset-complement gauges (full 16-row X^tau table + the {I,D,D_c,D_cD} Klein four's D_c/D_cD), verdict MIXED
v.finding: VERDICT SURVIVES. Independent re-derivation (own field theory via PARI/GP; own criterion function; a full from-scratch reimplementation of the object's cocycle/outer-solve machinery and 3-level K/N/Mbar field tower via sympy, executed against the real repo files with every stage cross-validated before use) reproduced the sweep's two sharpest new numbers bit-for-bit: lambda(D2D)=2304/953 and, at two freshly-constructed X^tau diagonals never before computed, lambda=864/413 and lambda=6912/3047 -- exact matches, all 6 named coupling triples agreeing at each gauge, exactly as claimed. Field theory (disc K=6237=3^4.7.11, O_K=Z[s], and the splitting shapes of every prime touched: 3 totally ramified, 7/11 each [1,2]-with-a-ramified-degree-1-place, 13/17/19 inert, 5/59/199/277/953 clean [1,2]-split) was independently confirmed via PARI/GP idealprimedec -- a different software route from the sweep's sympy -- with zero mismatches. THE CRITERION's PASS/FAIL calls were independently re-run (fresh code) on every denominator in the sweep (953, 413, 3047, 125, 35, 275, and the two B1076 corroborating controls) with identical results. Completeness of the control set was verified two ways: the code enumerates X^tau by brute force over all 64 sign patterns (asserted ==16, not a curated subset), and every one of the sweep's 16 rows (signs, flip count, H1 class) was cross-checked against B936's own pre-existing, repo-committed class table (results.json, independent of and prior to this sweep) with exact agreement on all 16 -- no cherry-picking, nothing missing. The full 18-gauge tally (2 non-degenerate PASS, 4 FAIL-occurrences of exactly 2 distinct values, 6 trivially degenerate, 6 with no well-defined lambda) was retabulated directly from the raw stageC_verdict.json and matches claim 6 exactly, and this tally does support the stated MIXED reading: no gauge anywhere produced a value outside {1, 2304/953, 864/413, 6912/3047} (BITES: never diluted), while every non-degenerate result merely echoes an already-banked number (VACUOUS: no independently-sampled fresh evidence) -- both confirmed true, independently, not just asserted. // Real defects were found, all in the narrative/explanatory layer, none in the arithmetic or the tally: (1) Claim 4 states classes (1,0)/(0,1) contain "none...C-compatible...census element" per B936's table -- false; B936's own table (independently read) shows each of those two classes has exactly ONE C-compatible member, and that member is precisely the row giving the well-posed "trivial lambda=1" result in each class -- a real, more interesting mechanism the sweep's own data supports but its prose gets backwards. (2) Claim 4's evidence sentence calling X^tau row (1,1,-1,-1,-1,1) "fully well-posed...not undefined...rather than partially undefined" directly contradicts the raw stageB_lambda.json (5 of its 6 triples ARE UNDEFINED_zero_product, only S0/S1/S2 is defined) and contradicts the claim's own main-body text two sentences earlier, which correctly describes this exact row as having "the OTHER 5 of their own 6 triples UNDEFINED." (3) Claim 7 mischaracterizes controlA (denom 5.199.3461.3517) as failing via "4 unrelated mid-size primes (none of them structure- or value-primes)" -- independently verified false: 3461 and 3517 are BOTH inert, i.e. carry the criterion's own "structure-prime signature" by the same general definition used everywhere else in the arc; only controlA3's description (13=structure, 953=value, 98729=unrelated-split) is accurate. (4) The headline's claim that lambda was "re-computed exactly at every one" of the 18 gauges mildly overstates the treatment of chi_a/chi_b, whose lambda values are inherited unchanged from the separately-banked B1076 arc (only their sign-diagonals were rebuilt and cross-checked in this sweep's Stage A) -- though this is disclosed accurately in the claims' own evidence text, so it is a headline-phrasing overreach rather than a hidden gap. None of these four defects change any computed number, the tally, or the verdict's logic; they are quality/carefulness defects in explanatory prose layered on top of arithmetic that independently re-derives correctly. Artifacts of this audit: (scratchpad) extra_denoms.gp, mine_criterion.py, mine_stageA_frame.py, mine_stageA_out.json, mine_stageB_lambda.py, mine_stageB_report.json, exactify_stdout.log}. git status --porcelain on the repo root was empty at the end of this session -- confirmed read-only throughout, matching the house guard.
